newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica Telkom, Maister merge directory operations.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica Telkom, Maister merge directory operations.

text.p: South African telecommunications utility Telkom said on Tuesday it had signed an agreement with Maister Directories for the two firms to merge their respective directory service operations from September 1.
Telkom said a new subsidiary would be created in which the state-owned firm would hold a majority 61 percent stake. The deal does not involve a cash transaction.

Telkom said it was in consultation with its recognised trade unions, the Communications Workers Union and the Alliance of Telkom Unions, with a view to enabling them to obtain a minority interest in the newly-formed subsidiary.
The subidiary will be responsible for directory services including the compilation of customer entries, selling of advertising space and distribution.
Telkom said it had had a long-standing association with Maister, which is jointly owned by the Maister family and ITT World Directories.
